Doctor of Nursing Practice

Salve Regina University’s DNP program is designed for those who have graduated from an accredited program (with a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0) and hold an M.S. in nursing. Building on your master’s, you’ll gain the education, evidence-based practice, and systems thinking you need to become a leader and an authoritative advocate in your field. Now is the time to focus on your future — let Salve Regina University’s fully online DNP program lead the way.

Pricing

$23,730 for nurses from partner institutions. $26,070 for nurses from non-partner institutions.

Flexibility

Complete the program in as few as 20 months with two start dates per year.

Benefits

Preferred tuition rate for nurses at partner institutions extends to spouses and family members as well as members of the military.

*Pricing reflects cost of nursing curriculum only

SALVE REGINA UNIVERSITY | DNP Program

Program Requirements

You will earn your DNP by completing 30 credits. All courses must be taken at Salve Regina University to obtain your advanced degree. To apply, you must have a master’s degree in nursing, hold an RN license (or eligibility for RN licensure in Rhode Island) or an APRN license and certification and you must have maintained a GPA of 3.0 or higher at your prior institution(s). All qualified students are eligible for admission regardless of race, color, age, gender, disability, religion or national origin.

Salve Nursing

Founded by the Sisters of Mercy in 1934, Salve Regina University is a Catholic institution known for excellence in learning and fueling the imagination of students to bring forward progressive ideas that marry intellect and spiritual growth.

We enroll nearly 2,700 undergraduate and graduate students from across the globe. Our programs are designed to support a world that is harmonious, just and merciful by integrating student experience and personal values with competency in theory and in practice.

  • Financial aid is available
  • Join our program to discover the difference Salve can make in your personal and professional life
  • Opportunities for professional development within a holistic model of education backed by the Mercy Mission
  • Preparation to address future health needs of various populations

Nursing Curriculum

Salve Regina University welcomes you! Our online DNP program is accredited by the Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education and the New England Commission on Higher Education, and builds on your M.S. in nursing. You will gain the education, evidence-based practice and systems thinking you need to become a leader and an authoritative advocate in your field.

Working toward your DNP highlights your leadership skills and empowers you to encourage others to embrace healthy living and social justice. Upon graduation, you will join other nursing professionals who have the influence to champion the well-being of individuals, families and communities. Ready to use your commitment to others to make an impact? Focus on your future and apply to Salve Regina University’s fully online DNP today.
